unique-A tolerance: _unique_a_authority and every other --all history scanner accept exactly one pinned creating-commit A touch plus additional A touches only when each additional touch is a merge commit's first-parent projection whose blob bytes equal the pinned digest byte-exactly; every other shape still fails
